revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor. Narrow service hallway with utility doors, exposed pipes, matte concrete non-glossy floor, partial shadow from nearby structure, clear subject detail. Right-oblique view at medium distance, natural perspective, realistic scale, enough surrounding context to judge body support. A visible young adult with medium build wearing a light work shirt and dark cargo trousers in brown and cream tones, sitting on a sturdy chair near the wall, with legs and seat support plainly visible. Plausible unedited inspection-camera capture, subject clearly visible, with a column or partition partly framing one side of the image. Ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, not cinematic or advertising. No text, caption, watermark, logo, warning label, overlay, bounding box, arrow, circle, or artificial annotation. No training signs, simulation text, medical staff, ambulances, first-aid equipment, cones, instruction boards, or dataset labels.
